newsitem.title: USA: Sullivan & Co names Patrick Waide COO.
newsitem.headline: Sullivan & Co names Patrick Waide COO.

text.p: Patrick Waide, an operating executive in the asset management and public accounting industries, has been named chief operating officer of Sullivan & Co, the international, executive-search consulting firm.

In this newly created position, Waide will maintain and improve the operating platform - which includes technology, finance, human resources and administration - that supports the firms's client-service delivery system, the company said.

For the last seven years, Waide, 58, has been a senior finance and administration executive and a member of the office of the president of the Bessemer Group Inc., the asset management and fiduciary trust company. He was also chief financial officer of the diversified financial holding company owned by the descendants of Henry Phipps.
